'''Eric Palomar''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[September 2000 Joliet tournament]] on 23 September 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA/Interceptor]], according to Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1267">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-joliet-illinois-9-23-2000d1267/ joliet-illinois-9-23-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-joliet-illinois-9-23-2000d1267/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
